profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Integration and Test Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in industrial automation. Strong engineering professional skilled in databases, web development using ASP.NET, and application development using Visual Basic and C#.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Maple Grove, Minnesota, United States · On-site

positions.title: Operational Intelligence / Application Integration Engineer
positions.description: Provided application integration solutions for several customers and internal projects.   Solutions included the following technologies:  Logbooks, ICONICS BridgeWorx, MatrikonOPC, DeltaV, C#.NET, SQL Server Database and Reporting Services, and VBA.

positions.title: Engineer Sr Semiconductor Manufacturing
positions.description:
Sensors Test Engineering Team Leader.  Responsible for test equipment software and hardware implementation for pressure and magnetic product lines.  

Responsibilities included project management, developing new test capabilities, upgrading software from VB6 to .NET, maintaining test equipment, fixture improvements, Gauge R&R, and failure analysis on returned parts.

positions.title: Owner - Consultant
positions.description:
•  Honeywell IT Systems Integration Analyst, migrating and upgrading several .NET applications
•  Honeywell Sensors Programmer, upgraded several test programs and performed test equipment customizations.
•  Provide engineering (control systems) project support for Novaspect Inc. in Eden Prairie, MN.  Several large projects to convert Provox to DeltaV.

positions.title: Senior IT Systems Integration Analyst and Team Leader
positions.description:
Application Group Leader responsible for the following items:
•  Prioritized work requests from department leaders
•  Assigned work requests to the proper internal IT resources
•  Met with internal customers to define requirements and scope projects
•  Coached IT group on various programming and project management techniques
•  Motivated team to keep projects on schedule and to achieve customer goals
•  Communicated IT group project status to site and regional leadership

Software Development and Project Management
Software developer and project leader responsible for the completion
•   Created many internal web applications using ASP.NET and classic ASP.  Notable functionality includes: Oracle database backend, Crystal Reports, output to Excel spreadsheets, XML, graphical representation of data, dashboards, role based views and functionality, shopping carts, shipping notification, return authorization, time card system, and demand forecasting.
•  Developed many database applications using Microsoft Access

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Control engineer on several paper machine rebuilds. 
Responsibilities included: configuration of Fisher Provox Distributed Control System (DCS) using a VAX 4100 and Alpha platform, extensive database management using Sybase (SQL) and Microsoft Access, building various customized tools to expedite configuration time (Visual Basic, database modules, C programming, OpenDB, and SQL), and developing detailed documentation for controls, layouts, user manuals, project framing and design.

positions.title: Process Control Engineer
positions.description:
Process Control Engineer 
Instrumentation and Electrical (I&E) Engineer
